about_the_game:
💥 Demo Description for Punch Champs

Welcome to the world of Punch Champs, a tactical brawler that challenges you to knock out your opponents and rise to claim the title of the GOAT. This fast-paced platform fighter blends strategic combat with dynamic arenas, ensuring no two battles are ever the same.

⚠️ About This Demo
This demo offers an early look at Punch Champs' core combat experience. Try local multiplayer matches, experiment with our one-hit KO mechanics, and get a feel for the responsive, strategic gameplay.

The full game is planned to include Online PvP, Cross-Platform Multiplayer, Achievements, Stats, Leaderboards, and full controller support (Xbox and PlayStation).

🎮 Best Played with a Controller
Punch Champs delivers the most precise and satisfying gameplay experience when played with a controller.

🧠 Simple, Deep, and Strategic
Easy to pick up, tough to master — every dodge, parry, and strike matters.

🥊 Contextual Combat System
Punches adapt in real time based on your movement, creating fluid and reactive fighting moments.

⚡ Power-Up Showdown
Strategically grab power-ups to shift the battle in your favor and turn close calls into stunning victories.

💥 Ultimate Knockout Thrills
Every knockout feels earned and explosive, rewarding precision and timing.

🛡️ Dance of Defence
Master parries to counter and strike back with devastating impact.

↔️ Push-Back Play
Use strategic push-back mechanics to control space, knock opponents into hazards, or dominate the arena edge.
